No taper, pressure, brush perimeter, texture, serif or blobs. Every stroke identical width approximately3% of square canvas; keep dense counters and gaps open. No text,labels,codepoint,frame,chart,grid,watermark,color,shadows or other specimens. Structural reading aid: Paired detached forks top.
